title: Probe snapshot
description: Normalized canonical response capture from the pinned vercel/serve reference for one probe case. Snapshots are written by `node tools/probe/run.mjs <id> --snapshot=update` and verified by `--snapshot=verify`. They are committed to the repository and serve as the Stage-3 source of truth for what the reference does. See docs/reference/serve/oracle-matrix.md.

$schemaVersion.description: Snapshot schema version. Bump only when the on-disk shape changes incompatibly.

fixture.description: Echo of the case fixture (files + serveJson). Recorded so a snapshot is self-contained.

volatileHeaders.description: Header names whose values are present-but-not-asserted during `--snapshot=verify`. The runner records the observed value (so it stays auditable in the snapshot file) but the diff treats the value as a wildcard. Default: ["last-modified"]. Override per case via `cases/<id>.json#snapshot.volatileHeaders`. Names are lowercase.

volatileBodies.description: Request names whose response body is volatile across runs (e.g., directory listings that embed the absolute fixture path, or generated error pages that include port-specific content). The runner still records body length / sha256 / preview for audit, but `verify` masks those fields for these request names. The body's `kind` (text|binary|empty) is still asserted. Override per case via `cases/<id>.json#snapshot.volatileBodies`.

requests.description: Per-request snapshot entries. Order matches the case's request list.

name.description: Echo of the request's name field from the case.

requestLine.description: Raw mode only: literal HTTP request line as sent on the wire (e.g., `GET /%2e%2e/etc/passwd HTTP/1.1`). Asserts that no client-side normalization sneaked in.

headers.description: Tracked response headers, name → value, all lowercase, sorted alphabetically.

preview.description: First 200 bytes of body decoded as UTF-8. Present only when kind is `text`.
